database.description: Exact MongoDB database that holds the collection.

collection.description: Exact collection, view or time-series collection name.

pipeline.description: Ordered read stages as MongoDB Extended JSON objects, each with exactly one stage operator, such as [{"$match": {}}, {"$count": "n"}].

row_limit.description: Maximum documents to return. Defaults to this connection's limits.max_rows from list_connections and must not exceed it.
